about.hero_eyebrow: Made by a player, for the community
about.hero_subtitle: One place to create tournaments, manage registrations, referee live, track stats and find all the players in the worldwide community.
about.for_orga_desc: Set up your page in minutes: dates, location, format, sponsors, poster. Manage registrations, run the draw, generate pools and brackets, and run matches live from the referee console. Everything in one place.
about.for_player_desc: Register your team online, follow results live, collect badges by playing tournaments and find every player in the community on their profile. Your player card is waiting.
about.feat_tournament_desc: Create a full event page: poster, sponsors, rules, registration dates, format (S.E. / Double Elim.), access code. Live in minutes.
about.feat_registration_desc: Teams register online. You see everything: dietary needs, accommodation, captain, automatic waitlist.
about.feat_schedule_desc: Draw, balanced pool generation, match schedule and final bracket in one click. All editable if needed.
about.feat_live_desc: Dedicated console to enter goals, built-in timer, golden goal, penalties. Scores update in real time for everyone.
about.feat_players_desc: Every player has their own collector card with photo, stats, country and badges unlocked automatically in tournaments. Hat-trick, champion, ironman — over 70 to unlock.
about.feat_squads_desc: Create your permanent team with logo and colors, invite teammates, chat internally. Teams persist from one tournament to the next.
about.feat_clubs_desc: Every club can have its own page with logo, city, description and member list. A good way to represent your city on the platform.
about.feat_orga_desc: Private space for co-organizers: task list with priorities and deadlines, shared notes, pinned links. Access the registration recap per team: dietary needs, accommodation requests, and the message left by the team. So nothing gets forgotten on the day.
about.step_create_desc: Name, location, dates, format, capacity, entry fee. Page is live in minutes.
about.step_register_desc: Players fill in their info and submit their team. The organizer gets everything in one place.
about.step_draw_desc: Draw, pools, match schedule, bracket — all generated automatically in one click.
about.step_play_desc: Referees enter goals live. Bracket and standings update as they go.
about.free_desc: Poloperator is maintained by a member of the bike polo community. No subscription, no ads, no data sold.
about.card_section_desc: Every player gets their own collector card with photo, stats and badges. Badges unlock automatically — by playing tournaments, scoring golden goals, organising events, chatting… and plenty of surprises. Over 70 badges with up to 5-star rarity.
about.contact_title: An idea? A bug? Just saying hi?
about.contact_subtitle: This project is maintained by one person in the community. Your feedback genuinely matters.
about.contact_message_placeholder: Tell us what's on your mind…
about.contact_error: Send failed. Please try again in a moment.
about.contact_sent_desc: Thanks for reaching out. We'll reply as soon as possible.
about.stagger1_desc: Follow every goal and score in real time from any device.
about.stagger2_desc: Generate pools automatically with seeding optimization.
about.stagger3_desc: A clear bracket, updated live all the way to the podium.
about.stagger4_desc: All matches of a tournament on one page, updated in real time.
about.stagger5_desc: Log goals, manage the clock and golden goal directly from your phone.
about.stagger6_desc: Points, goal difference, qualifications — all calculated and displayed instantly.
about.showcase_map_title: Every tournament in the world, on a map
about.showcase_map_desc: Find tournaments near you or plan your next polo trip on the other side of the world. Filter by format, date and continent.
about.showcase_calendar_desc: View all upcoming tournaments month by month. Never miss a tournament — or add yours.
about.showcase_clubs_desc: Find bike polo clubs worldwide. Join your local club or create yours in a few clicks.
about.showcase_formats_desc: Single elimination, double elimination, ABC, ABC Chapeau — all formats used in bike polo are natively supported.
about.feat_map_desc: Explore tournaments on an interactive map. Filter by format, continent and dates.
about.feat_calendar_desc: Monthly view of all upcoming tournaments.
about.feat_formats_desc: Native support for ABC and ABC Chapeau formats with A, B, C level assignment per player.
about.feat_notifications_desc: Registrations, team invites, unlocked badges, messages — never miss anything with real-time notifications.

legal_charter.title: Community Charter
legal_charter.intro: By using Poloperator, you agree to follow these rules. This charter applies to all exchanges on the platform: private messages, team and tournament chats.
legal_charter.s1_text: Every person must be treated with respect, regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, religion or skill level. Offensive or degrading remarks are not tolerated.
legal_charter.s2_text: Harassment, insults, threats or hate speech towards other members are strictly forbidden, whether public or private.
legal_charter.s3_text: Fair play is at the heart of bike polo. Adopt a sporting attitude in your exchanges and when submitting results. No cheating, no bad-faith disputes.
legal_charter.s4_text: Unsolicited messages, commercial advertising, off-topic links or any form of spam are prohibited in conversations.
legal_charter.s5_text: If you witness inappropriate behaviour, report it to the tournament organisers or the administration via the contact form rather than responding aggressively.
legal_charter.s6_text: Any breach of this charter may result in a warning, temporary suspension or permanent deletion of the account, depending on the severity.
